title: Knee Injury Prevention (CDC)
summary: Guidelines to reduce risk of knee injuries in athletes using training, landing mechanics, strengthening, and safe workload progression.
risk_factors: Rapid workload increases (too much too soon)
protective_factors: Technique coaching for landing and cutting
recommendations: Use a dynamic warm-up before sport (5''10 minutes)
Train landing: soft knees, hips back, knees track over toes
Increase training volume gradually (avoid big weekly spikes)

ai_signals.notes: Hip hinge engagement reduces knee load.
Single-leg stability reduces knee injury risk.
